name: shunt
description: Delegate large reads to subagents to save main-agent context.

interface.longDescription: A vendored, patched fork of Spotify's shunt plugin from portal-ai-plugins. Hooks block full large-file reads on Claude Code, Copilot CLI, and Devin, and large Bash reads on Codex. They redirect agents to the bulk-reader skill. Small reader subagents return concise answers with line citations; chunked reads handle exact content and edits. See plugins/shunt/upstream-source.md for source and patch details.
defaultPrompt: Use the bulk-reader skill to summarize this large file.
